_comment: The opponent's OWN land entry trigger, on purpose: opponent_list Angels (Seraph Sanctuary x4; the scenario default White Knights has no ETB-lifegain land). Same board as invigorate_not_lethal_no_fire (opp at 4, Tainted Remedy, no ready attacker). Invigorate's free alt cost alone leaves the opponent at 1, but the opponent's Seraph Sanctuary ETB 'gain 1 life' is flipped by our Tainted Remedy into a loss, so the opponent's own land drop finishes it on turn 4. Guards that the passive opponent's ETB life gain happens at all (2026-11-21 land-entry fix) and goes through the shared life-gain path.
